findingDetails.title: plannedNotePath copied into five adapters and drifted on path resolution
findingDetails.scopeProof: function inventory shows five definitions: codex/shared.mjs:65, claude/context-nudge.mjs:59, hermes/context-nudge.mjs:66, pi/session-relaunch.ts:180, opencode/session-relaunch.js:56; relaunch-core.cjs exports no path builder
findingDetails.case: A runtime hook and the relaunch CLI run with different working directories, or REPO_ROOT is relative; Claude and Codex return a relative note path while Hermes and Pi resolve it, so prepare validates a different path than the sender intended.
findingDetails.evidence: Claude and Codex join process.env.REPO_ROOT || payload.cwd || process.cwd() without path.resolve; Hermes and Pi wrap the same root in path.resolve.
findingDetails.recommendation: Move the builder into lib/relaunch-core.cjs or lib/paths.cjs with one resolution rule and call it from every adapter.

findingDetails.title: Pi adapter re-reads hook config per event and keeps a fourth threshold copy
findingDetails.scopeProof: four relaunchThreshold definitions (claude:53, codex:57, hermes:57, pi:167) with two resolution styles; lib/nudge.cjs owns state and text but not threshold policy
findingDetails.case: An operator edits hook-flags.env while a Pi session runs; the enable check and threshold can come from different file snapshots in one event, and every assistant message performs two synchronous config reads that the Claude path explicitly avoids.
findingDetails.evidence: isEnabled() loads the config and relaunchThreshold() loads it again per message_end; claude/context-nudge.mjs:73-76 documents the read-once design the Pi path does not follow.
findingDetails.recommendation: Load the config once per event or activation and pass it to a single shared threshold resolver.

findingDetails.title: notePathFromSeed has three divergent parsers across adapters
findingDetails.scopeProof: three definitions found by function inventory: hermes/context-nudge.mjs:80, pi/session-relaunch.ts:194, opencode/session-relaunch.js:152; the seed prefix literal is also duplicated as SEED_COMMAND at hermes/context-nudge.mjs:19
findingDetails.case: The wrapper seed wording gains a leading marker or changes its separator; a parser updated in one adapter still passes its own test while the other two render a claim prompt with a placeholder or a truncated path.
findingDetails.evidence: Hermes requires the prompt to start with the full prefix, rejects relative and non-trimmed paths and returns null; Pi searches for the marker anywhere, unescapes shell escapes and falls back to the literal placeholder.
findingDetails.recommendation: Put one notePathFromSeed in lib/nudge.cjs returning a discriminated result and let adapters choose only the fallback text.
